statements.t: The Company continues to target LAI schizophrenia portfolio (UZEDY and WELTRUZA) with peak sales potential of $1.5 billion–$2.0 billion.
Teva’s biosimilars business continued to expand and is currently expected to exceed $0.8 billion in 2026 revenues, achieving our original 2027 revenue objective one year ahead of plan.
